<b>Servitors Ignim</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are small constructs built by the [[Weavers]], brought to life by [[Silk]] runes threaded within them.<ref>Servitor Ignim [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Small construct built by Weavers past, brought to life through Silk runes threaded within."</i></ref> They passively patrol the [[Weavenest]]s, awaiting the return of the Weavers.<ref>Servitor Ignim [[Needolin]] dialogue: <i>"...watch their halls... ...await their return..."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Servitors Ignim have no attacks. Instead, they follow [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]], shining a spotlight on her. They can be seen on floors and ceilings around the Weavenests, trying to get as far away from Hornet as possible while still keeping her in sight. After some time, if Hornet goes too far away, they return to a dormant state. They do not deal contact damage.

Servitors Ignim cannot be damaged by the cloud of venom spawned after using the [[Plasmium Phial]] or the [[Flea Brew]] while the [[Pollip Pouch]] is equipped, by the [[Claw Mirror]] explosion, or by [[Tacks]]. They also do not activate [[Sting Shard]]s or trigger the ignition of runes placed using the [[Snare Setter]]. [[Cogflies]] do not attack Servitors Ignim, [[Pale Nails]] do not target them, and the [[Wispfire Lantern]] does not spawn [[Wisp]]s if a Servitor Ignim is nearby.

Broken Servitors Ignim found on the floor count as enemies for the special healing of the [[Beast Crest]] and [[Witch Crest]]. Like functional Servitors, they respawn only after Hornet rests at a [[Bench (Silksong)|bench]].

Upon destruction, both broken and functional Servitors Ignim drop a fragment of their bodies. If the fragment falls from a great height, it shatters into {{S|2}} by itself. Otherwise, it can be instantly destroyed with a [[Needle Strike]], or hit with a regular attack, which causes it to bounce and break upon a second impact with a surface.

== Location ==
Functional Servitors Ignim can be found in [[Weavenest Atla]], [[Weavenest Cindril]], and [[Weavenest Murglin]]. A unique Servitor Ignim can be encountered in Weavenest Atla after using the lift for the first time: it runs away to the left exit and never respawns.

Broken Servitors Ignim can be found in [[Weavenest Absolom]], the Weaver chambers on [[Mount Fay]], Weavenest Cindril, [[Weavenest Karn]], and Weavenest Murglin.

== Trivia ==
* Playing the Needolin near broken Servitors Ignim that can be found on the ground in the Weavenests makes them sputter and flicker.
* The head-orb design for Servitors Ignim is used for the Weaver "heat lamps" in [[Mount Fay]].
